scope: Two owned disposable local Vere 4.6 ships using current working desks
boundary: The browser used a virtual WebAuthn authenticator and the passkey record was imported through the official CLI. This verifies encrypted vault-data recovery and cryptographic use of the restored key; it does not demonstrate official extension passkey UI, physical-device behavior, an existing-installation upgrade, or recovery of a running ship's pier. No personal vault was used.
